title: Analysis of LLM Vulnerability to GPU Soft Errors: An Instruction-Level Fault Injection Study
abstract: arXiv:2601.19912v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are highly compute- and memory-intensive, posing significant demands on high-performance GPUs. At the same time, advances in GPU technology driven by shrinking transistor sizes and lower operating voltages have made these devices increasingly susceptible to soft errors, particularly in radiation-prone environments such as satellite computing scenarios. While prior work has examined GPU soft errors, most studies have focused on general-purpose applications or conventional neural networks primarily used for vision tasks such as classification and detection. However, vulnerability analysis of modern LLMs remains limited, despite their rapid adoption in diverse application scenarios. Given the unique characteristics of LLMs, their resilience to soft errors may differ substantially from earlier models. translated_title: 大语言模型对GPU软错误的脆弱性分析：一项指令级故障注入研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）具有高度的计算和内存密集性，对高性能GPU提出了巨大的需求。与此同时，受晶体管尺寸缩小和工作电压降低驱动的GPU技术进步，使这些设备越来越容易受到软错误的影响，尤其是在卫星计算场景等辐射易发环境中。虽然已有研究考察了GPU软错误，但大多数研究集中于通用应用程序或主要用于分类和检测等视觉任务的传统神经网络。然而，尽管现代大语言模型在各种应用场景中被快速采用，但针对它们的脆弱性分析仍然有限。鉴于大语言模型的独特特性，其对软错误的恢复能力可能与早期模型存在显著差异。为了填补这一空白，我们首次对大语言模型推理开展了指令级故障注入研究……
tldr: 本文首次针对大语言模型推理开展指令级故障注入研究，系统分析了LLM对GPU软错误的脆弱性，填补了现代大模型可靠性评估领域的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first instruction-level fault injection study on LLM inference, systematically analyzing LLMs' vulnerability to GPU soft errors and filling a gap in the reliability assessment of modern large language models.
